title: Large 5BR Home on 30A with a Shared Pool & Beach Access
meta_description: Stay at Memory Maker, a 5BR, 4.5BA private home on 30A with a communal pool, gated private beach access, and a full kitchen. Sleeps 14.
description_expanded: Nestled on the borders of Eastern Lake and in the private Summer's Edge community is your family's next dream vacation at Memory Maker.Memory Maker is a newly updated, spacious 5-bedroom, 4-bath family home (with Tesla charger!). Just steps from the large, shaded community pool and the gated private beach access, your family will be comfortably accommodated. Thoughtfully updated furnishings throughout the home provide a fresh and refined feel. Inside, you’ll find generous living areas, an open kitchen ideal for entertaining, and a great spot to enjoy cocktails and sunset views.Looking for some pool time? Just take a quick 20 second walk to the beautiful community pool that is heated year round. Just around the corner is the private/gated beach access. This is just a 2 minute walk from door to gate!1st Floor:Living space with TV and sofa sleeperBedroom 1: King bed with TV and private bathBedroom 2: 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunksBedroom 3: 2 twins and TV, shared bathroom with Bedroom 2.2nd floor:Open floor plan with full kitchen and dining for 10Bedroom 4: king bed with TV and private bathBalcony with open seating and Gulf views3rd floor:Master king suite with TV and private bathCrow's nest style lookout on balcony with ample seating and daybed swing to enjoy Gulf viewsYour stay at Memory Maker comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!-Portable crib (sheets not provided)-Outdoor shower-Gas Grill-Tesla Charger* Parking for 3 vehicles (1 vehicle in driveway; 2 on parallel parking pad)* Golf carts are not allowed in the Summer's Edge community.* Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.
